gg G < >         top / bottom

PgDn / PgUp      page down / up                                                 
Enter            open the task                                                  
Tab / Shift-Tab  mark the next / previous column                                
o                order by the marked column: ▲ ▼ off                            
t / d / x        take / done / drop the task                                    
e                edit in $VISUAL, else $EDITOR, git core.editor, vi             
J / K            move below / above the next row, no confirm                    
m                grab: j/k move it, Enter places it                             
y, P p           yank, then paste above / below                                 
s / c            state palette / clear all filters                              
: grouping       flat, by group, by epic: cycles                                

EVERYWHERE
v o/i/b/!      views: overview / list / board / lint; i b ! alone too           
/              live find; Enter goes to it, Tab keeps it as a filter            
:              palette: commands with completion

               <s>, type <t>, priority <p>, group <g>, label <l>, assignee <a>, 
               epic <id>, goto <id>, sort, grouping, lint, clear, help          
#              jump by id prefix or TASK-number alias                           
f              filter picker: s/t/p/g/l/a/e                                     
1 / 2 / 3 / 4  filter todo / doing / done / depends                             
Backspace / F  remove the last chip / clear all filters                         
: sort         order by fields; : sort rank goes back                           
N              new task                                                         
S              copy the screen, Enter attaches it to the task                   
r              refresh now (changes on disk show by themselves)                 
Enter / Esc    confirm / cancel every editing action                            
e again        after an edit left a finding: edit at once                       
?              this help, from anywhere; / finds in it                          
Esc            back one level, never quits                                      
q / ctrl-c     quit (q only outside inputs)
